## CRM Adapter
Sub-workflow. Translates one generic CRM operation into a GoHighLevel (API v2) or HubSpot (CRM v3) API call. Add a new CRM by adding a branch here — nothing else changes.

Ops: update_fields · add_tags · set_dnd · add_note · create_task · upsert_opportunity
Input: `{crm_type, crm_contact_id, location_id, op, payload, lead_id}`
